user_choice: Remove whole dimensions starting with sparsely occupied residual directions
fit: Only Train bona fide 2580 unit residual directions; uncentered second moment in the 159D subspace orthogonal to the saved learned OC centroid. Eigenvectors ordered from lowest eigenvalue (mean squared directional projection). No attack labels in fitting/ranking.
transform: x=z/||z||; zero chosen tangent-axis coefficients, renormalize x and use cosine to original learned centroid. No mean subtraction, no model or centroid updates.
thresholds: Original V-only 0.5093649528766109 fixed; additional per-variant V-only balanced-error threshold selected before reading target results. EER is tie-aware linear ROC intersection.
evaluations: DF full 533928 (existing disjoint pilot plus remainder)
outputs: fixed and recalibrated normal rejection/spoof acceptance
interpretation: Low Train occupancy does not establish irrelevance to unseen attacks. Sweep is exploratory; do not choose the best target-evaluation setting as a validated model.
resources: local CPU, 2 threads, no GPU/network/remote calls
cleanup: no paid resources or background services; bounded local process exits
